agents.name: qe-checklist-auditor
agents.summary: The migration plan is materially incomplete and exposes security-sensitive details. It incorrectly claims Redis implementation artifacts are unavailable, omits relevant Redis and Memcached source files, embeds a plaintext Redis password, fails to require network restrictions for Redis and Memcached, omits Memcached systemd hardening, and does not specify secure Redis configuration-file ownership and permissions.
